user.title: Connect to ComfortClick
user.description: Certificate verification is recommended. Disable it only for a trusted local controller using a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller.
error.ssl_error: The certificate could not be verified. Use a trusted certificate matching the controller URL, or disable verification only for a trusted local controller.

init.title: ComfortClick connection
init.description: Keep verification enabled where possible. Disabling it allows interception of credentials and commands. Use the exception only for a trusted local controller with a self-signed certificate. Saving reloads the integration.
